decision.explanation: Documents d00 and d01 describe American Airlines Flight 63 (1943) as a Douglas DC-3, while document d02 incorrectly identifies the same 1943 flight as a Boeing 747-178 (an anachronism); documents d04, d05, and d06 describe a distinct Toa Domestic Airlines Flight 63 (1971) as a NAMC YS-11A-217.
